data: What is the approximate value of the function ψ when x-axis value is 0.2?

The question asks for the approximate value of the function ψ when the x-axis value is 0.2. From the caption, we know that the function ψ is represented in red. By examining the graph at x = 0.2, we can see that the red line (representing ψ) is approximately at the 0.8 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the function ψ when x-axis value is 0.2 is 0.8.
